Hi all —

Quick checklist and upload details for Nov 9 session:
1) Redaction checklist (summary):
   - Remove direct PII (full names, SSNs)
   - Tokenize internal account IDs (we accept hashed IDs)
   - Strip or separately upload free-text clinical notes unless you want them included as test prompts (ok to provide both)
2) File formats we prefer: newline-delimited JSON (.ndjson) or CSV with a single prompt column. Include a small metadata file (metadata.json) with schema version and record counts.
3) S3 upload:
   - Bucket: redwood-poc-uploads/nexgen/4521/
   - Put files under staging/ and set ACL to private.
   - IAM role to use: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-poc-uploader
4) Runbook & scripts: runbook-v1.md (in Drive link) and s3-upload-instructions.txt (attached).

We’ll also run a dry ingest on Tuesday morning (08:00–09:00 PST) to sanity-check schemas if you can put the files up by Monday EOD. For the load test plan, Marissa will orchestrate; I’ll provide a small harness that replays prompts at configurable concurrency.

Attachments: runbook-v1.md, s3-upload-instructions.txt

Thanks,
